name: OBS Studio 33.0.1 for Windows x64, the official zip from the OBS project's GitHub release
note: The checksums are the digests GitHub publishes for the release's assets; desktop/ci/fetch-obs.sh refuses a download that does not match. linux_ubuntu is the Ubuntu the Linux package is built for, which the image with the real OBS (desktop/ci/obs.Dockerfile) runs. The scheduled workflow obs-bump.yml opens a pull request when a newer stable release is out.
